articlesAll.title: Responding to Halloween
articlesAll.summary: The date of 31 October is an interesting one. It is All Hallows Eve (meaning the day before All Saints Day), and it is also Reformation Day. In days of yore (and still today in Poland and other countries), 1 November was a day of feasting to celebrate the lives of saints and martyrs.
